name: Deck Listening
description: Open an Anki deck export and play the recordings already in its cards as a listening playlist, in the order and with the pauses you choose, without touching your review schedule.
problem: Language learners with audio in their Anki cards want to rehear it hands-free, but Anki only plays a card's audio during a review you grade, and the add-ons that export a deck to audio are broken, Windows-only, or need command-line tools.

rejection.reason: The forum requests it cites want to replay today's reviewed cards without a daily export, which an export-reading app can't offer; Audio Flash already imports Anki decks with their audio for hands-free study on Android and iOS; and storing user-authored decks needs a personal-data decision.
